approved: Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Amendment (Miscellaneous Matters) Bill 2015

Introduced a consequential bill amending the Offshore Petroleum and Greenhouse Gas Storage Regulatory Levies Act to add cross-boundary exploration permits to the definition of Commonwealth title, ensuring the National Offshore Petroleum Titles Administrator can recover its costs for regulating them.
